[[Rundil ot Sulem]] owned a '''ranch''' on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date 1">The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]],'' including the interactions with [[Lur Arka Sulas]], in [[3956 BBY]]. Sulas states that [[Sasha ot Sulem|Sasha]] had been kidnapped several years prior to his conversation with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].</ref> a group of [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] raided the [[Farm/Legends|farm]] and kidnapped ot Sulem's daughter, [[Sasha ot Sulem|Sasha]]. ot Sulem hired a [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Lur Arka Sulas]] to help find her, and Sulas carried out a search that lasted many years. Eventually, in 3956 BBY,<ref name="Date 2">The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]],'' including the interactions with [[Lur Arka Sulas]] and [[Sasha ot Sulem|Sasha]], in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> Sasha was found aboard the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', the ship belonging to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Revan returned Sasha to Sulas, who in turn brought her back to her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] at the ranch.
